_readme.switches: true = show this ad / turn this on, false = hide it / turn it off. Every ad has its own switch.
_readme.ad_network: Which ad network serves the ads: admob | meta | pangle | levelplay | both (AdMob first, Meta as backup) | all (AdMob, then Meta, then Pangle) | none (no ads anywhere).
_readme.ad_ids: Ad unit ids for each network (text). Only the ones for the chosen ad_network are used. Leave "" for unused networks.
_readme.app_open.cooldown_seconds: Number. Minimum seconds between two app-open ads. 0 = no limit.
_readme.app_open.launch_wait_seconds: Number. On a fresh start, how many seconds the app-open ad may take to load. If it is slower, it is skipped instead of popping up later. Default 10.
_readme.game.launch_ad: Ad when a game starts: interstitial | rewarded | both (alternates: interstitial, then rewarded, then interstitial...) | off.
_readme.interstitials.cooldown_seconds: Number. Minimum seconds between two full-screen ads (interstitials, the game-start ad; an app-open ad also counts), counted from when the previous ad closed. 0 = no limit.
_readme.interstitials.every_n: Number. Show an interstitial only every Nth time one could show (2 = every second time). 0 = every time.
_readme.remove_ads_reward.minutes: Number. How many minutes without pop-up ads the user gets after watching the reward video.
_readme.review.min_opens_before_prompt: Number. App opens before the rate-us prompt can appear.
_readme.review.days_between_prompts: Number. Days to wait before showing the rate-us prompt again.
_readme.review.play_store_id: Text. Package name the rate-us prompt opens on the Play Store. Empty = this app.
_readme.maintenance.title / message: Text shown on the maintenance screen when maintenance.enabled is true (the app is blocked).
_readme.update.title / message: Text shown on the update screen when update.enabled is true (the app is blocked).
_readme.update.new_package_name: Text. Package name of the new app to send users to. Empty = this app's own Play Store page.
_readme.telegram.title / message: Text of the Telegram invite popup.
_readme.telegram.channel_url: Text. Link opened by the Join button, e.g. https://t.me/yourchannel.
_readme.telegram.min_opens_before_prompt: Number. App opens before the Telegram popup can appear.
_readme.telegram.days_between_prompts: Number. Days to wait before showing the Telegram popup again.
